scope: Desktop Microsoft Word DOCX and Excel XLSX read-only opening and PDF export evidence. This is not visual approval, formula correctness proof, repair-free proof, or coverage of PPTX/OpenDocument formats.

executionEvidence.reason: The implementation environment is Linux without desktop Microsoft Office or PowerShell. The Windows acceptance run remains mandatory.

prerequisites: Dedicated disposable Windows VM with interactive signed-in desktop, licensed and activated Microsoft Word and Excel, and Windows PowerShell 5.1 (Desktop edition). Do not run as a service or shared user session.
Install the actual production fonts and record their versions in the review evidence; Office build and Windows version are captured automatically.
Complete Office first-run dialogs before testing. Close all Word and Excel processes; do not launch Office manually during the run.
Use only operator-reviewed, trusted fixture files. Disconnect VM networking; COM link-update switches do not sandbox external connections, embedded content, add-ins, or templates.
Snapshot the VM before each acceptance matrix. Do not disable Protected View, Trust Center, or security policy merely to obtain a passing run.

Fixture paths may be local absolute Windows paths or portable paths relative to the manifest directory. Relative paths cannot contain parent traversal or escape that directory. UNC/network drives, alternate data streams and symlink/junction paths are rejected. OutputDirectory must not exist. Preserve output evidence privately when fixtures contain customer data.

statuses.opened-and-exported: Office opened the hash-pinned input and exported a nonempty PDF; input hash was unchanged. Does not establish visual correctness or absence of repair/warnings.
statuses.failed: Opening, export, hashing or cleanup failed; cannot approve.
statuses.timeout: Per-fixture child process exceeded the deadline; cannot approve. Recorded Office process is stopped only if its PID and start time match.

exitCodes.0: All fixtures opened and exported; human acceptance is still required.
exitCodes.1: At least one failure or timeout, or PowerShell invocation/configuration error.

reportContract.cleanupLimit: If COM activation stalls before the HWND/PID can be recorded, the parent cannot safely identify that Office process. Stop the run, inspect the VM and restore the snapshot. No global Office process killing is attempted.

scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Customer-approved invoices, contracts, multi-page tables, headers/footers, page breaks, Unicode/RTL, long words, empty repeats, nested repeats and style-heavy documents.
scenarioMatrix.expected: Open/export; human checks all pages against approved baseline; verify clipping, overflow, pagination and fonts.

scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Restarted numbered lists, footnotes/endnotes, classic comments, inline rasterized SVG, charts and supported reusable components, including zero/one/many repeats.
scenarioMatrix.expected: Open/export and inspect placement, IDs, list continuation, note references, legends, images and links; unsupported combinations must already fail in renderer tests.

scenarioMatrix.fixtures: All supported formulas including errors, empty values, negative operands, relative/absolute references, repeating rows, styles, charts and print areas.
scenarioMatrix.expected: Open/export; independently inspect Excel calculated cells against expected values. PDF output alone does not verify hidden cells or formulas.

scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Operator-created encrypted DOCX/XLSX with passwords deliberately not supplied to the runner.
scenarioMatrix.expected: Failure or bounded timeout. No password request is answered and no protection is removed. Store negative runs separately from positive acceptance runs.

scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Read-only recommended, protected worksheets and documents with editing restrictions.
scenarioMatrix.expected: Read-only open/export when permitted by Office policy, otherwise explicit failure. No claim of supporting removal of protection.

scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Trusted operator-created files carrying Mark-of-the-Web and fixtures blocked by configured Office policy.
scenarioMatrix.expected: Preserve Office protection settings. Capture outcome and any warnings manually; failure/timeout is not a positive acceptance. Never automatically unblock fixtures.

scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Truncated ZIP, missing relationships, malformed XML and independently prepared known-repair prompts.
scenarioMatrix.expected: Reject or time out with no requested repair. Operator separately opens exact hash-pinned fixture in interactive Word/Excel and records whether any repair was offered/performed; automatic success is insufficient.

scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Known slow large test file or known modal-prompt fixture, run with a five-second timeout.
scenarioMatrix.expected: If Office exceeds deadline, record timeout, terminate only the owned PID, preserve partial evidence, and verify no unrelated applications were affected. Repeat normal case afterwards in a restored VM.

scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Reviewed DOCX with external fields/templates and XLSX external workbook references, including invalid renamed macro-bearing negative fixtures.
scenarioMatrix.expected: Use network-disconnected VM. Observe no external workbook updates; macros must not execute. ForceDisable does not cover Excel 4.0 macros, so reject macro-bearing fixtures from the supported positive set and record any prompts manually.

scenarioMatrix.fixtures: Missing file, changed hash, duplicate IDs, invalid IDs, UNC/network drive, parent traversal, alternate data stream, symlink/junction escape, oversized manifest/file, wrong extension, existing output directory, relative fixture basenames/subdirectories and paths containing spaces/apostrophes.
scenarioMatrix.expected: Invalid inputs fail before Office launch; valid local absolute paths and manifest-relative paths with spaces/apostrophes work independently of the process working directory. Never overwrite prior evidence.

humanAcceptance: Review exact input hashes, application versions/builds, generated PDF hashes and every result. Keep the renderer source commit and fixture provenance with the evidence.

Independently open each supported positive fixture interactively, without accepting repair. Record reviewer, date, Office build, input hash, no-repair/no-warning observation and visual verdict. The runner intentionally sets interactiveWarnings to unknown.
Review exported pages against customer-approved baselines, including layout and accessible reading order where required; inspect spreadsheet formulas/cells directly.
Do not label failures or missing fixtures as passes. Negative robustness outcomes demonstrate bounded handling only, not document compatibility.
No report produced by this runner can by itself approve a release. Keep releaseApproved false until the separate release acceptance procedure verifies the required human and automated evidence.

manifestLimits.pathResolution: Resolve portable paths against the manifest directory; copy the manifest and fixture folder together to the Windows VM. Absolute local Windows paths remain supported. Input must remain unchanged throughout the run.
